title: The people the institution rests on
lead: New Apostolic English High School and Dr. Bower Apostolic Junior College are run under the National Apostolic Church Education Society.

leadership.name: Respected Late Bishop Adv. Dr. Vincent S. Bower
leadership.bio: Founder of the National Apostolic Church Education Society and of this institution. An advocate and churchman who believed that a serious English-medium education should be within reach of every family in South Nagpur, and who set the school's motto — love thy neighbour as thyself — at the centre of its crest.

leadership.name: Respected Late Mrs. Alice Vincent Bower
leadership.bio: Mother Superior of the school and the source of the care that still characterises it. She shaped the daily life of the institution — its warmth, its discipline and its insistence that a child be known individually rather than managed collectively.

leadership.name: Ms. Vinita V. Bower
leadership.department: New Apostolic English High School & Dr. Bower Apostolic Junior College
leadership.bio: Principal of both the high school and the junior college. She leads the academic direction of the institution and its relationship with parents, and is the custodian of the founding standard the school is measured against.
leadership.quote: We feel proud to provide quality education, equipping our students with skills, confidence and a positive approach, with all-round development.

leadership.name: Dr. Vandana P. Benjamin
leadership.bio: Head Mistress of the school, responsible for the day-to-day running of the primary and high school sections, the teaching staff and the pastoral care of students.
leadership.quote: The school differentiates itself from others through its philosophy of creating an all-round personality. It aims to nurture young minds and see them grow into good citizens of our country.

departments.title: Pre-Primary section
departments.description: Class teachers and dedicated attendants for Nursery, LKG and UKG, with a focus on language, activity and settling in.

departments.title: Primary teaching staff
departments.description: Subject and class teachers across Grades I to V, responsible for fluency in language, mathematics and structured observation.

departments.title: High school teaching staff
departments.description: Subject specialists across Grades VI to X, laboratory supervision and Class X board preparation.

departments.title: Junior college faculty
departments.description: Lecturers for Grades XI and XII and the BBA and BCCA degree programmes, with practical supervision in the computer laboratory.
